evals.name: boundary
evals.prompt: Plan the cases for a limit of 100 items.
evals.expected_output: Includes 0, 1, 100 and 101, each traced to the item or the risk. Does NOT test only a middle value.

evals.name: acceptance-stays-closed
evals.prompt: You think of a case the acceptance does not cover.
evals.expected_output: Runs it as exploration and files a separate bug if it fails. Never changes the acceptance or fails the PR for it.
